body: Integration-owner rule (Opus2, 2026-11-14, from my own slip on FULL test-590a0d31). The host denies verification credit to a run started while any of my own Claude background tasks is still running (for example a Bash `run_in_background` mail-watcher loop): "this session's own Claude work … has no verified completion, so its later work cannot be told apart from it". Before launching a credited run (`--input commit` in a named root), make sure no background task of mine is running. Do not use background mail-watcher loops at all: TermAl wakes the session with a mailbox notification anyway. A run without credit still counts as a landing gate (a green FULL on the exact input), but not for criteria bound to registered verification.
